modern: All existing things soon change, and they will either be turned into vapour, if indeed all substance is one, or they will be scattered.
original: All existing things soon change, and they will either be reduced to vapor, if indeed all substance is one, or they will be dispersed.
notification: All existing things soon change, and they will either be turned into vapour, if indeed all substance is one, or they will be scattered.
notification_original: All existing things soon change, and they will either be reduced to vapor, if indeed all substance is one, or they will be dispersed.

explained.summary: Everything that exists will soon change. Either it will be turned into vapour, if all matter is ultimately one substance, or it will be scattered into its separate atoms. Marcus doesn’t mind which theory is right. On either view, nothing you see around you is going to last.
